title: overlay.save() ONLY persists LOCAL_FIELDS — new fields must be added to that list
summary: SCAR-TISSUE GOTCHA: overlay.save() serializes ONLY the fields in LOCAL_FIELDS = ["git", "cancel_requested", "stop_requested", "config", "judgedAtEpoch", "judgeCursor", "judgedClusters", "distinctClusters"]. Any NEW field (like diagnostics, featureFlags, etc.) added to EMPTY() but NOT to LOCAL_FIELDS will NOT survive a save()/load() round-trip — load() returns EMPTY() defaults. Fix: add the new field name to LOCAL_FIELDS inside save(). This bites every overlay extension that does not read the save() implementation carefully.
